sentences.en: You don't have proper dignity as chief of the section.
sentences.zh: 作为部门主管，你没有应有的尊严。

sentences.en: It is beneath my dignity to ask a favor.
sentences.zh: 我自视甚高，不屑于求人帮忙。

sentences.en: The prisoner of war bore himself with great dignity.
sentences.zh: 战俘表现出了极大的尊严。

senses.zh: 尊严，自尊；庄严，端庄，庄重；尊贵，高贵，高尚；高位，显职
